record.title: Venezuela election closure at Santa Elena–Pacaraima, May 2018
record.direction: Official crossing movement between Venezuela and Brazil; full nationwide or all-crossing scope not established.
record.movement: Vehicles and pedestrians at the official Santa Elena–Pacaraima crossing; informal routes remained usable.
record.exceptions: Informal crossing routes reportedly continued; lawful exemptions not established.
record.enforcement: Contemporary reports describe Venezuelan-side closure; a May 21 report confirms restored vehicle and pedestrian passage through named regional official, but source is a G1 rewrite.
record.relationship: Resolved prior lead R11-AM-L001. Distinct from August 2018 Brazilian judicial suspension R2-AM-006.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Security and sovereignty during the May 20 Venezuelan presidential election, attributed to Venezuelan authorities.
record.context: Venezuelan-side election measure; distinct from Brazil refusing a state request to close its own side.
record.uncertainty: Start conflicts: MRE report says May 18 at 21h; local report says midnight May 19. Indexed-only copy describes a later May 19 10h pedestrian phase. Different category phases and clock conventions unresolved; no exact start or continuous interval assigned. Original G1 not retrieved.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible: disputed onset and category phases.

claim_checks.Historical note — current findings are i: Contemporaneous reporting describes an election-related Venezuela–Brazil closure and actual reopening.
MRE-attributed May 18 at 21:00 differs from local May 19 midnight; preserve contested start and do not select one.
May 21 morning reopening is reported with Roraima international-affairs confirmation; planned 06:00 is not exact observed clock time.

Hierarchical coding: see Rationale coding for subcategories, attribution and phases. The recorded rationale and claim assessment support the selected subcategories. All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): Election security supports Electoral politics and Security as already coded.
Pacaraima/Santa Elena passenger and vehicle crossing restrictions; irregular-path movements do not mean universal enforcement.
Contested start and category phases prevent an exact interval. Portal Amazônia repeats G1 material and is not another independent origin.
